'''Hosko''' was a verdant agricultural [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] on the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], not far from [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. It was orbited by a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] frequented by traders and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] on Hosko discovered buried ancient weapons and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on an [[Battle of Hosko|abandoned battlefield]]. An [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] studying the findings determined that they were artifacts from the [[Hutt Cataclysms]], when factions of the [[Hutt Empire]] fought each other.<ref name="Under">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Under Hosko's Fields}}</ref>
